about: Every number the mechanics use. One row = one TUNING.<id> struct {value,min,max,unit,exposed}. exposed rows get a slider in the CET overlay and are saved to settings.json.

rows.label: Gravity while webbing
rows.about: Downward acceleration while the mod drives the player; heavier than real for a snappy swing

rows.label: Top speed
rows.about: Velocity length cap in every state

rows.label: Air drag
rows.about: Fraction of speed lost per second in ballistic flight

rows.label: Swing arm delay
rows.about: Airborne time before a held jump starts a swing, so a normal jump is not stolen

rows.label: Web range
rows.about: Longest web the swing can attach

rows.label: Anchor pitch min
rows.about: Lowest elevation above horizontal searched for an anchor

rows.label: Anchor pitch max
rows.about: Highest elevation searched for an anchor

rows.label: Anchor yaw spread
rows.about: Left/right spread of the anchor search fan around the camera heading

rows.label: Shortest web
rows.about: Reel-in stops at this rope length

rows.label: Reel speed
rows.about: Rope shortens this fast while swinging, adding lift

rows.label: Swing floor clearance
rows.about: The web is shortened so the bottom of the arc stays this far above the ground under the player (Spider-Man 2 never scrapes the street)

rows.label: Fast reel
rows.about: How fast the web shortens toward the floor-clearance length, felt as a pull at the start of a swing

rows.label: Swing pump
rows.about: Horizontal acceleration toward the camera heading while swinging

rows.label: Release fling
rows.about: Extra speed along the velocity when released while moving upward

rows.label: Wall slide keep
rows.about: Share of tangential speed kept after hitting a wall in flight

rows.label: Glide speed
rows.about: Web-wings horizontal cruise speed

rows.label: Glide sink
rows.about: Web-wings maximum descent speed

rows.label: Glide turn rate
rows.about: How fast the glide velocity eases toward the camera heading

rows.label: Zip range
rows.about: Longest web zip

rows.label: Zip speed
rows.about: Straight-line speed while zipping

rows.label: Zip pop
rows.about: Upward speed added on arrival

rows.label: Ground probe
rows.about: Below-feet distance that counts as near the ground

rows.label: Ground clearance
rows.about: Height above the hit the player is placed at hand-back
